title: cotoneaster uva-ursi
intro: Cotoneaster uva-ursi, commonly known as Bearberry or Kinnikinnick, is a low-growing, deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe, Asia, and North America. The plant has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of urinary tract infections and kidney stones due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster uva-ursi are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including arbutin, which has been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. Arbutin and other compounds present in the plant, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, may contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
